diagnosis: The carried-position acquisition correctly retained post-roster transaction history, but the evaluator required a future executable open even after a former member reached its last verified positive-activity bar. Binance may then publish canonical zero-trade placeholders before omitting the symbol, and the initial recovery detected only immediate omission. That organizer-owned liquidation shortfall paused the first point without producing a terminal.
remediation: For a carried former member only, when its current bar is the last verified positive-activity transaction bar and the next boundary is either absent or a zero-trade placeholder, force-settle the residual at the current close with ordinary costs and no participation cap. A complete active-to-placeholder audit also identified RNDRUSDT, MATICUSDT, and FTMUSDT as selected-member cessations omitted from the activation audit; a separately hash-bound organizer-recovery audit adds those three verified windows. Membership, targets, scoring, and candidate bundles are unchanged.
resume_policy: Use the existing organizer-failure resume record for the already-started point; do not retry, replace, or restart any candidate terminal.
